headline: SVP Global Textiles files AGM scrutiny report and voting results
hook: SVP Global AGM voting results submitted
summary: SVP Global Textiles Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing submitted to the stock exchange. The filing details the outcome of shareholder voting on resolutions presented at the meeting. For an Indian retail investor holding the stock, this completes the procedural formalities of the annual meeting.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price.

headline: SVP Global Textiles holds annual general meeting
summary: SVP Global Textiles Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Routine shareholder meetings involve the adoption of financial statements and voting on standard resolutions. For retail investors, such filings represent mandatory corporate compliance rather than material business catalysts. This disclosure has no immediate impact on the company's operational outlook or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no direct impact on share price
